name: Yonomori Tsukiyo
source:
She is a third-year student at St.Trea Academy and the head of the PC game club. She is a calm and innocent Japanese beauty. 

She has a mature appearance and is sexy beyond her years. She is the daughter of a president of a large corporation. 

Her language is polite and her behavior is graceful. When she plays games, she is a completely different person; she is calm, collected, and shows a keen intellect.
